title: B1 Milestone 2: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has superado el Segundo Hito del Nivel B1. Estás dominando el vocabulario de reuniones, finanzas y consejos profesionales.

parts.visual:
En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 6 a 9 del nivel B1: 
- Giving Advice (Should vs Ought to). 
- Meetings & Interruptions (May I interrupt? Hold on, wrap up).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 6 to 9 of the B1 level: Giving advice using Should and Ought to, and vocabulary for Meetings and Interruptions.

parts.visual:
- Present Perfect: For vs Since (I have worked here for 2 years / since 2020). 
- Company Performance (Revenue, profit, loss, bankrupt, break even). 
¡Buena suerte!
parts.audio: We will also review the use of For and Since with the Present Perfect, and vocabulary about Company Performance. Good luck!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador (Lecciones 6-9).

questions.question: You ____ send that email. It's too aggressive. (No deberías).
We ____ to hire more staff before the summer. (Deberíamos - formal).
questions.explanation: Como está el 'to', la única opción correcta es 'ought' (ought to).

questions.question: May I ____ for a moment? (¿Puedo interrumpir...?).
Let's get back to the ____. (Tema principal).
questions.explanation: Get back to the point = volver al punto/tema central.

questions.question: Could you speak ____? I can't hear you. (Más alto).
I have worked in this company ____ five years. (Por 5 años).
We have been waiting ____ two hours. (Por 2 horas).
I haven't seen him ____ Monday. (Desde el lunes).
Our total income from sales is our ____. (Ingresos brutos).
After paying expenses, the remaining money is the ____. (Ganancia neta).
We didn't make money, but we didn't lose any. We broke ____. (Punto de equilibrio).
The small store went ____ during the crisis. (A la quiebra).
We need to reduce our ____ to make a profit. (Gastos).
____ I talk to human resources about this? (¿Debería yo...?).
Can I ____ something here? (Agregar/Añadir a la conversación).
The company's shares dropped, meaning we are operating at a ____. (Pérdida).
questions.explanation: Operate at a loss = operar con pérdidas.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa el repaso escribiendo la palabra correcta.

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase de tu examen final.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We ought to hire more staff.
options: We ought to hire more staff.
They ought to hire more staff.
We ought to fire more staff.
questions.correct_answer: We ought to hire more staff.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: May I interrupt for a moment?
options: May I interrupt for a moment?
Can I interrupt for a moment?
Must I interrupt for a moment?
Should I interrupt for a moment?
questions.correct_answer: May I interrupt for a moment?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: We need to wrap up the meeting.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I have worked here for five years.
options: I have worked here for five years.
I have worked here since five years.
I work here for five years.
I worked here for five years.
questions.correct_answer: I have worked here for five years.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We made a huge profit this year.
options: We made a huge profit this year.
We made a huge loss this year.
They made a huge profit this year.
We make a huge profit this year.
questions.correct_answer: We made a huge profit this year.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We hope to break even soon.
options: We hope to break even soon.
I hope to break even soon.
We hope they break even soon.
We hope to break out soon.
questions.correct_answer: We hope to break even soon.
